svg.title: Map of Wisconsin's 7th Congressional District
svg.desc: The district's 26 counties shaded by population change since 2020; split counties show only the part inside the district and are hatched.
svg.text: Who lives where, and how it is changing
Population change by county, April 2020 to July 2025. Hatched counties are split; only the part in the district is drawn.
Sources: U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundaries (119th Congress) and Population Estimates, Vintage 2025.
